integrity_notes: Symbolic proof for arbitrary characteristic-two fields; exhaustive matrix computations over fields of orders two and four are finite corroborations. No independent external mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats exactly the reduced square-zero derivation locus on the two-variable height-one characteristic-two truncated algebra; no assertion about the scheme structure, more variables, full nilpotent cone, or conjugacy classification.
title: The reduced restricted nullcone of the two-variable characteristic-two Witt derivation algebra
